statement: let W := fun (A B : Finset ℕ) (n : ℕ) => ((A ×ˢ B).filter (fun t => t.1+t.2=n)).card; ∀ (m n : ℕ) (A B : Finset ℕ), 2 ≤ m → n+2 ≤ m → (∀ a ∈ A, a < m) → (∀ b ∈ B, b < m) → W A B (n+m) = W (A.image (fun a => m-1-a)) (B.image (fun b => m-1-b)) (m-2-n)

plain_statement.zh: 把进位层反射成低端整数的路径计数
plain_statement.en: Reflect wrapped paths into a low-end integer count

brief.zh: 两个坐标分别关于 m−1 作反射，用反射的自逆性保持路径重数。可用低端的支撑或筛界估计伪命中。
brief.en: Reflect both coordinates about the endpoints of [0,m−1]. An involution preserves multiplicity and gives access to low-end bounds.
